HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN  BENCH AT JAIPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 839/2023 Amrat S/o Shri Radheyshyam, Aged About 18 Years, R/o Semlabeh Police Station Dangipura, District Jhalawar (At Present In Central Jail Jhalawar)
 ----Accused-Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through PP  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Dharmendra Choudhary

sentences.text: For Respondent(s) : Mr. Chandragupt Chopra, PP and Mr. Namo Narain Meena for complainant HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ASHUTOSH KUMAR Order 20/01/2023
The present bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.179/2022 registered at Police Station Dangipura, District Jhalawar for the offence under Section 376 IPC.

It is contended by the learned counsel for the applicant- petitioner that the applicant is a young boy of just about 18 years of age, he has falsely been implicated in this case, the prosecutrix and her parents have also arrived at compromise with the accused-petitioner, copy of the compromise has also been produced before this Court, the accused is in jail for a long time so he should be released on bail.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.
However, Shri Namo Narain Meena has marked his presence as counsel for the prosecutrix and her parents.
He has also supported the version of the counsel for the applicant to the effect that the compromise between the parties has been arrived at.
The prosecutrix and her family has no objection if the accused is released on bail.

Taking into consideration the contentions advanced by learned counsel for the applicant-petitioner and that learned counsel for the prosecutrix and the fact that accused is of the tender of age 18 years and 1/2 months and the fact of compromise between the parties; but, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court deems it just and proper to enlarge the applicant-petitioner on bail.
Amrat S/O Shri Radheyshyam vs State Of Rajasthan on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114137273/
1

Accordingly, the bail application is allowed and it is directed that accused-petitioner Amrat S/o Shri Radheyshyam shall be released on bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. in connection with afore-mentioned FIR registered at concerned Police Station, provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac only) together with two sureties in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) each to the satisfaction of the trial Court with the stipulation that he shall comply with all the conditions laid down under Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
(ASHUTOSH KUMAR),J MADAN/72 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
